data.narrative:
SiFly is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $15M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $15M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $30M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median of this subset is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B, reflecting material heterogeneity within the peer cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $26M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $215M. This wide spread reflects tension between the stage-progression method, which anchors to observed fundraising, and peer-median, which captures outsized valuations among frontier-defense players. Key uncertainties include capital intensity relative to peer development trajectories, competitive differentiation within the defense sector, and the binary risk profile inherent to early-stage frontier technology.
